ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure, the left and right sides are vertical wires, and there are three horizontal branches between them. The upper branch contains resistor R1 and switch S1, the middle branch contains resistor R2 and switch S2, and the lower branch contains resistor R3 and switch S3. Crosses are drawn inside the dashed-line frame, indicating that in this region there is a magnetic field perpendicular to the paper surface and directed inward; the middle branch passes through the dashed-line magnetic-field region, dividing the magnetic-flux region corresponding to the dashed-line frame into two adjacent upper and lower parts. When any two switches are closed, the corresponding two branches and the left and right vertical wires form a closed loop. Then reason: Let R1:R2:R3=1:2:3, so R1=r, R2=2r, R3=3r. When S1 and S2 are closed and S3 is open, the total resistance of the loop is R1+R2=3r, and the induced current is I, so the induced electromotive force of this loop is ε12=I·3r=3Ir. When S2 and S3 are closed and S1 is open, the total resistance of the loop is R2+R3=5r, and the induced current is 5I, so the induced electromotive force of this loop is ε23=5I·5r=25Ir. When S1 and S3 are closed and S2 is open, the magnetic-flux change enclosed by the large loop is equal to the sum of the magnetic-flux changes of the upper and lower two parts, therefore ε13=ε12+ε23=3Ir+25Ir=28Ir. At this time the total resistance of the loop is R1+R3=4r, so the induced current is I13=ε13/(R1+R3)=28Ir/4r=7I.

method.method_draft: 先从图像读出：三条水平支路分别含R1、R2、R3和开关S1、S2、S3；任意闭合两个开关就由对应两条支路和左右竖直导线组成一个闭合回路；虚线磁场区域被中间支路分成上下相邻两部分，S1-S3形成的大回路包围的磁通变化量等于S1-S2回路与S2-S3回路包围磁通变化量之和。由文字读出R1:R2:R3=1:2:3，设为r,2r,3r，且两种已知电流分别为I和5I。用欧姆定律和法拉第定律：S1、S2闭合时总电阻为3r，所以对应感应电动势ε12=I·3r；S2、S3闭合时总电阻为5r，电流为5I，所以ε23=5I·5r=25Ir。目标情形S1、S3闭合时包围上下两部分磁通，故ε13=ε12+ε23=28Ir，总电阻R1+R3=4r，因此电流为ε13/(4r)=7I。

再推理：设R1:R2:R3=1:2:3，所以R1=r，R2=2r，R3=3r。当S1、S2闭合、S3断开时，回路总电阻为R1+R2=3r，感应电流为I，所以该回路感应电动势ε12=I·3r=3Ir。当S2、S3闭合、S1断开时，回路总电阻为R2+R3=5r，感应电流为5I，所以该回路感应电动势ε23=5I·5r=25Ir。当S1、S3闭合、S2断开时，大回路包围的磁通变化量等于上、下两部分磁通变化量之和，因此ε13=ε12+ε23=3Ir+25Ir=28Ir。此时回路总电阻为R1+R3=4r，所以感应电流为I13=ε13/(R1+R3)=28Ir/4r=7I。

method.method_draft: 先从图像读出可把虚线框内被中间支路分开的两块磁通区域看成两个“感应源”：上块对应S1与S2构成的回路，下块对应S2与S3构成的回路；S1与S3构成的外回路等效为串联包含这两个感应源。由文字设R1=r、R2=2r、R3=3r。把上块磁通变化等效电动势记为E上，下块记为E下。已知S1、S2闭合时，只有上块源驱动R1+R2，所以E上/(r+2r)=I，得E上=3Ir。已知S2、S3闭合时，只有下块源驱动R2+R3，所以E下/(2r+3r)=5I，得E下=25Ir。目标S1、S3闭合时，中间支路断开，外回路中R1和R3串联，等效电动势为E上+E下=28Ir，因此电流为28Ir/(r+3r)=7I。
method.CoT_raw:
图像显示：电路有上、中、下三条横向支路，分别含电阻R1、R2、R3，右侧分别由开关S1、S2、S3控制；三条支路左端连在同一导线上，右端也连到同一侧导线。虚线框内画有叉号，表示垂直纸面向里的匀强磁场，且中间支路穿过虚线框，把虚线框内的磁通区域分成上、下两块：上块对应由S1、S2闭合形成的上-中回路，下块对应由S2、S3闭合形成的中-下回路；当S1、S3闭合而S2断开时，外回路包围上下两块磁通区域。

按题给电阻比，设R1=r，R2=2r，R3=3r。把上块磁通变化产生的等效感应电动势记为E上，下块记为E下。

当S1、S2闭合、S3断开时，闭合回路只包含R1和R2，总电阻为r+2r=3r，感应电流为I，所以E上=I·3r=3Ir。

当S2、S3闭合、S1断开时，闭合回路只包含R2和R3，总电阻为2r+3r=5r，感应电流为5I，所以E下=5I·5r=25Ir。

当S1、S3闭合、S2断开时，中间支路断开，外回路只包含R1和R3，总电阻为r+3r=4r；该外回路包围上下两块磁通区域，等效感应电动势为E上+E下=3Ir+25Ir=28Ir。因此电流为28Ir/4r=7I。

raw_record.original_question: 虚线框内存在均匀变化的匀强磁场，三个电阻R1、R2、R3的阻值之比为1∶2∶3，导线的电阻不计。当S1、S2闭合、S3断开时，闭合回路中感应电流为I；当S2、S3闭合、S1断开时，闭合回路中感应电流为5I。那么当S1、S3闭合、S2断开时，闭合回路中的感应电流是多少？
raw_record.final_cot:
First describe the image: In the figure, the left and right sides are vertical wires, and there are three horizontal branches between them. The upper branch contains resistor R1 and switch S1, the middle branch contains resistor R2 and switch S2, and the lower branch contains resistor R3 and switch S3. Crosses are drawn inside the dashed-line frame, indicating that in this region there is a magnetic field perpendicular to the paper surface and directed inward; the middle branch passes through the dashed-line magnetic-field region, dividing the magnetic-flux region corresponding to the dashed-line frame into two adjacent upper and lower parts. When any two switches are closed, the corresponding two branches and the left and right vertical wires form a closed loop.

Then reason: Let R1:R2:R3=1:2:3, so R1=r, R2=2r, R3=3r. When S1 and S2 are closed and S3 is open, the total resistance of the loop is R1+R2=3r, and the induced current is I, so the induced electromotive force of this loop is ε12=I·3r=3Ir. When S2 and S3 are closed and S1 is open, the total resistance of the loop is R2+R3=5r, and the induced current is 5I, so the induced electromotive force of this loop is ε23=5I·5r=25Ir. When S1 and S3 are closed and S2 is open, the magnetic-flux change enclosed by the large loop is equal to the sum of the magnetic-flux changes of the upper and lower two parts, therefore ε13=ε12+ε23=3Ir+25Ir=28Ir. At this time the total resistance of the loop is R1+R3=4r, so the induced current is I13=ε13/(R1+R3)=28Ir/4r=7I.
